digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot service startup composition and auth lifecycle
propositions: Long-running MCP and review-bot processes re-read static Gerrit/GitHub/LLM/telemetry config on every operation instead of binding once at startup, causing inconsistent state and requiring full restart to pick up policy changes
MCP inbound bearer tokens and OAuth material can leak into operation snapshots, logs, schemas, or child process environments instead of remaining request-scoped and transient

Review-bot validates decision-bearing auth lazily inside operation handlers instead of before accepting a job/webhook, and does not forward composed LLMRuntime to adapters, causing fallback to unchecked principals
Ambient config reads via load_config() and legacy composition facades prevent enforcement of startup-binding-once semantics and delay auth validation
Telemetry setup (Langfuse/OTLP) failures with invalid credentials propagate into operation results instead of failing open and disabling telemetry only
Static binding rotation (env/file changes) should require process restart; native SDK-owned credential refresh should remain in-process and unaffected
